description: Codec (org.jwcarman.codec) is a type-safe serialization abstraction for Java: libraries depend on Codec<T>, and applications choose a backend such as Jackson, Gson, Protobuf, JSON-B or Fory, with composable compression and encryption, Kafka and Spring Data Redis support, and Spring Boot auto-configuration.
rules: Import org.jwcarman.codec:codec-bom and add codec modules without versions.
Library code should depend only on Codec<T> and CodecFactory from codec-core, leaving the backend to the application.
In Spring Boot add codec-spring-boot-starter plus one backend module; outside Spring construct the backend's factory directly, e.g. new JacksonCodecFactory(objectMapper).
Check https://github.com/jwcarman/codec/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md against the codec version in use: entries under Unreleased are not in any release yet.
